settings.heading: Information Display
settings.description: As an aurora chaser and photographer as well as a hot air balloon crew chief from Alberta Canada who spends a great deal of time taking photos during the night and early morning’s the temperature can be quite chilly and even frigid at times,especially during our long Canadian winters. I needed to find ways to stay warm so I can spend more time capturing photos of this beautiful country.

settings.heading: Q2: How does Venustas heated apparel change your lifestyle?
settings.body: A: As an aurora chaser and photographer as well as a hot air balloon crew chief from Alberta Canada who spends a great deal of time taking photos during the night and early morning’s the temperature can be quite chilly and even frigid at times,especially during our long Canadian winters. I needed to find ways to stay warm so I can spend more time capturing photos of this beautiful country. . My Venustas heated Vest has been a game changer for me. The heated panels keep my back and neck and chest areas very  warm with out being bulky. And it packs up easily and compactly in the waterproof pouch.

settings.heading: Q3: Which part most appealing to you about Venustas?
settings.body: A: I appreciate the warranty and the quality of the product.

settings.heading: Q4: How do you feel about Venustas heated apparel?
settings.body: A: This vest is stylish and comfortable and the battery lasts much longer than I expected.

settings.heading: Q5: The reason to be our V+ Master.
settings.body: A: These products fit into my active lifestyle and and I look forward to seeing and trying new products and styles while promoting these items as I continue on my photographic adventures!
